summary_zh: 今日僅一則相關訊息：越南與四個非歐盟歐洲國家於河內簽署自由貿易協定，相互取消或降低工業、海產及農產品關稅。對在越華商製造業而言，這可能改變出口成本結構與接單策略，財務與業務部門宜及早評估新市場機會。
summary_en: One relevant item today: Vietnam signed an FTA in Hanoi with four non-EU European countries, cutting or removing tariffs on industrial, seafood and farm goods. For Chinese-owned manufacturers in Vietnam, this may reshape export costs and order strategy.

items.title: 越南與四國簽署 FTA
items.summary_zh: 越南與四個非歐盟歐洲國家於河內簽署自由貿易協定，相互取消或降低工業、海產及農產品關稅。
items.summary_en: Vietnam signed a free trade agreement with four non-EU European countries in Hanoi, mutually eliminating or reducing tariffs on industrial, seafood and agricultural products.
